entries.title: Task keys open their tasks wherever you see them
entries.body: A task key in a task's record, a card's title or thread, Activity, or Settings → Usage is now a link, as it already was in a card's words. Rest on it to see that task's summary, and click it or press Enter to open the task. A task's own key on its own card stays as it is.

picture.alt: A blocked task's record with its other tasks' keys underlined as links, and the summary of the task it waits on open beside it
